phaseTitle: Mockup swap + editor wiring + spec enrichment

tasks.title: Relocate Gemini mockup + visually inspect layout
tasks.notes: DONE. Image was an AETHER AI landing-page mockup (2816x1536), not an in-app control surface as the original task description implied; acceptance calibrated to actual zones (nav, hero+CTA, 4-tile video row, footer). SHOULD FIX for downstream iterations (from spec-reviewer): (a) tighten hasCta regex to drop generic 'button' — require 'CTA' or 'Get Started'; (b) clean up empty-alternation in hasNav regex; (c) document tests/swap/ directory convention; (d) paragraph says 'three social-icon glyphs' — image has two icons + decorative sigil, T-SWAP-04 should verify; (e) reconcile 2816x1536 hub.layout dims with §12 scroll-viewport spec (1920x1080 viewport, ~3200 content) — scale factor needed in T-SWAP-06; (f) paragraph lacks approximate pixel coords for zones, forcing re-inspection in T-SWAP-04. OPTIONAL: parenthetical linking §-IMAGE-TO-UI to CLAUDE.md; split paragraph into bullets for machine-scan; .gitignore leftover scifi-mockup-v2/v3 + generate-mockup-v2/v3.mjs before Phase G closes.

tasks.title: Write segment-video.mjs (SAM 3 w/ concrete-noun prompts, save RLE)
tasks.notes: Pattern from scripts/segment-scifi.mjs. Use fal-ai/sam-3/image-rle with include_boxes:true and concrete nouns ONLY (button, card, icon, input, video tile, bar, panel). Save RLE masks to notes/mockup-candidates/ai-video-mockup.sam.json. Do NOT try abstract terms (text, heading, link) — they fail. Cost: ~$0.005 per call.

tasks.title: Debug overlay script (SAM bboxes rendered on mockup)
tasks.notes: Pattern from scripts/debug-scifi-boxes.mjs. Emit notes/mockup-candidates/ai-video-mockup.overlay.svg with colored rectangles for each SAM bbox + label. Gives visual QA before committing to a per-node crop map.

tasks.title: Hand-tune BBOX map for every visible node in home-hub.json
tasks.notes: Each text block = own node. Each of the 4 play-button video tiles = own node (nodeId pattern: video-slot-1..4). Write scripts/extract-video.mjs that reads the BBOX map and writes source-images/cropped/<nodeId>.png for each. Document the BBOX map inline as a `const BBOX = {...}` so it's reviewable.

tasks.title: Apply alpha-cutout (per-image threshold override for this palette)
tasks.notes: scripts/alpha-cutout.mjs already exists with LOW=18, HIGH=55 luminance thresholds. The Gemini image may have a different dark-tone baseline — add a per-image threshold override (LOW_OVERRIDE / HIGH_OVERRIDE env vars). Run against every cropped <nodeId>.png so backgrounds turn transparent. Skip the full-mockup page-background image (it keeps opaque slate).

tasks.title: Patch home-hub.json: per-node transforms, hub.layout, strip stale fields
tasks.notes: Update hub.layout { viewportWidth, contentHeight } to the Gemini image dimensions. For each node: visual.sourceAsset = cropped/<nodeId>.png, visual.x/y/width/height set from the BBOX map, remove stale Phase-F state-variant regionKeys (except notifications-toggle). Nodes absent from the mockup get the invisible placeholder pattern: 2×2 transparent PNG at (−1,−1).

tasks.title: Rebuild .prism + three-gate verify
tasks.notes: npm run build:prism → npm run verify:prism (15/15) → node scripts/browser-smoke.mjs (6/6). Fix any drift before proceeding. artifactHash must be reproducible across two consecutive builds.

tasks.title: Ship + live-modes-smoke 8/8 on Vercel
tasks.notes: git commit + push prism-main, wait for Vercel deploy, then node scripts/live-modes-smoke.mjs against the production URL — all 8 checks must pass. If the deploy 500s transiently, empty-commit retrigger.

tasks.title: Mark the 4 video-slot nodes with intent.behaviorSpec.interactions[playback]
tasks.notes: Each of video-slot-1..4 in home-hub.json gets intent.behaviorSpec.interactions = [{ trigger: 'pointertap', effect: 'playVideo', src: '<sourceAsset>.mp4' }]. This is the explicit hook the runtime reads to know this is a playable video, not a static image.

tasks.title: Add interactive-element classifier note to prism-spec-extract.md
tasks.notes: Append new section §-SPEC-ENRICH describing the post-segmentation classifier pass: after SAM returns bboxes, a classifier prompt (to a vision model, not hand-coded rules) identifies play-button-like regions, prompts the user for 'user-supplied content vs auto-generated', and emits the interactions[] entry automatically. For now this is a design note — T-VID-03 wires the generation half.

tasks.title: WAN 2.7 i2v placeholder video generation (SKIP if user provides content)
tasks.notes: PROMPT USER FIRST via a status commit: 'Supplying your own video files for video-slot-1..4? If yes, drop them into source-videos/ and re-run T-SWAP-07. If no, I will generate 4 placeholder clips at 4×$0.50 via fal-ai/wan/v2.7/image-to-video.' Only proceed to generation on explicit confirmation. Cost ceiling: $2.00.

tasks.title: Audit window.__prism API surface + document in notes/editor-bridge.md
tasks.notes: Read src/lib/prism/player/boot.ts, identify every property hung off window.__prism. Document the shape: graph, nodes (Map), events (EventEmitter), viewport, currentBreakpoint, hiddenNodeIds, hubRouter. Write the shape as a TypeScript interface block into notes/editor-bridge.md. Flag anything the editor needs but isn't exposed yet.

tasks.title: Click-to-select: pointerdown on each node container emits node-selected event
tasks.notes: In boot.ts, for every node container registered, attach a pointerdown listener that fires window.__prism.events.emit('node-selected', { nodeId }). Add ALLOWED-GRAPHICS marker on any new hit-area if needed. Generic: no hardcoded nodeIds — iterate graph.nodes.

tasks.title: Inspector panel reads selected nodeId → shows intent.caption + transform + stateEffects
tasks.notes: src/components/editor/panels/Inspector.tsx subscribes to window.__prism.events.on('node-selected', ...). Reads graph.nodes.get(id) and renders intent.caption, transform.{x,y,z,scale}, stateEffects. Purely generic — no hardcoded nodeIds (anti-drift hook blocks them).

tasks.title: Inspector edits → mutate graph + re-apply on preview pane
tasks.notes: Inspector transform.x/y/z fields become controlled inputs. On change, write through to window.__prism.nodes.get(id).container position/scale AND mutate graph.nodes[id].transform. No persistence yet (T-ED-11 owns that).

tasks.title: SearchPalette ⌘K → fuzzy-search graph.nodes by nodeId + caption
tasks.notes: src/components/editor/SearchPalette.tsx binds ⌘K. Reads window.__prism.graph.nodes, fuzzy-matches input against nodeId + intent.caption. Selecting a result fires node-selected event — Inspector reacts automatically. Zero hardcoded IDs.

tasks.title: DetailCard shows sourceAsset preview + metadata for selected node
tasks.notes: src/components/editor/panels/DetailCard.tsx renders an of visual.sourceAsset (resolved from .prism/assets/) plus serviceTag, parentHubId, codeRef, backendRef. Generic — reads whatever the selected node has.

tasks.title: HubNav tabs route to hubs present in loaded .prism
tasks.notes: src/components/editor/HubNav.tsx reads manifest.hubs (array of hubIds). Renders a tab per hub; tabs for hubs not in the current manifest are disabled+greyed. Current .prism ships only home-hub, so Galaxy/Dashboard/etc. should render disabled.

tasks.title: Minimap renders actual graph.nodes count + active-node highlight
tasks.notes: src/components/editor/Minimap.tsx reads window.__prism.graph.nodes and draws a scaled-down rect per node using its transform. On node-selected, highlight the active rect. Reacts to currentBreakpoint changes.

tasks.title: Generic-editor audit: grep editor code for hardcoded mock-app node IDs
tasks.notes: Add a CI-style script scripts/audit-editor-genericity.mjs: greps src/components/editor/** for string literals matching the hardcoded-nodeId regex from anti-drift-check.sh. Zero matches required unless ALLOWED-HARDCODED-ID marker is present. Add to verify:prism as a 16th check.

tasks.title: Drag-on-preview: pointermove updates transform.x/y live
tasks.notes: Optional nice-to-have. Add a toggle in Inspector: 'Drag mode: off | on'. When on, pointerdown+move on a selected container updates container.position AND mirrors into graph.nodes[id].transform live. pointerup commits. No persistence (T-ED-11).

tasks.title: Save-to-home-hub.json: Inspector 'Save' button writes live transforms back
tasks.notes: Inspector 'Save' button calls a dev-only API route (src/app/api/save-graph/route.ts) that accepts { nodeId, transform } and writes back to src/lib/prism/mock-app-source/hubs/home-hub.json preserving deterministic JSON formatting (2-space, LF, trailing newline, key order). Dev-only: route 404s in production.
